important_knowledge: System defines product handoffs and four cross-owner work/failure walkthroughs. Skill delegates requirement refinement, proof criteria and judgment instead of repeating them. Design uses current Installation authority, reconciles compatibility scenarios and marks the superseded DES-DEC-04 state-write choice historical. Workflow owns coordination and navigation without obsolete authoring actors. Assessment consolidates formal recording, independent reassessment and historical-reliance explanations.
retired_material: Removed duplicated owner prose, obsolete state-writing installation instructions, obsolete original-path retention mandates and past-tense adoption ceremony presented as current steps. Source-transfer inventories remain after current behavior/scenarios/decisions, preserving all existing heading anchors and requirement rows. No document, skill, executable, schema, template or external state is removed or changed by this refinement.
historical_preservation: All existing requirement rows are byte-identical within each model, and all prior headings remain present. Source-qualified transfer maps and historical judgment records preserve their scopes and identities; DES-DEC-04 explicitly records supersession rather than erasing the original choice. Prior model identities are recorded above. Earlier reviews do not approve these changed subjects.

walkthrough_observations.observation: Scope can remain small without waiving whole-change review before governed final Verify.
Workflow consumes milestone judgments; integrated proof and final assessment remain separately required.
Finding is recorded before correction; responsibility returns to Design, Plan or Implementation according to the faulty subject; assessor owns renewed reliance.
CLI owns conflict/recovery, actor rereads current basis, and Assessment owns applicability; save success alone never renews approval.

limits: These are author walkthroughs and current-contract reconciliation, not independent assessment or runtime execution evidence. Independent Design Review, any required Delivery allocation/consumer implementation, whole-change Code Review and final Verify remain outstanding for the wider cleanup.

validation.procedure: python scripts/test-skill-validator.py; python scripts/test-boundary-first-validation.py; python scripts/validate-boundary-first.py --check with --path for System, Skill, Design, Workflow and Assessment; python scripts/validate-documentation-prose.py --mode enforce with --path for all five models and source-disposition; git diff --check; git diff --cached --check; author comparison of prior requirement rows, heading anchors and new local link destinations.
validation.summary: Final skill suite passed 354 tests and boundary/model suite passed 87 tests after reordering. Model structure/reference checks passed; prose passed with zero errors/warnings. All existing requirement rows are unchanged, all prior heading anchors remain and new local link destinations exist. Net reduction is 1,589 whitespace-delimited words across five models. Current Installation destination/force/state policy was checked against its owning requirements. No full CI, runtime installation, independent review or final Verify claimed.
